covers: Asian and European trading and US pre-market on Monday 23 Nov 2026, the rand, bonds and commodities during the JSE session, and South African company and ratings news for the week
headline: Nvidia up about 8% before the US open as the Treasury says it will look into its China chip sales; US futures up 2-3%, rand firmer near R17.43
summary: The rand firmed about 0.9% to R17.43 per dollar early on Monday 23 Nov 2026 and the yield on South Africa's 2035 government bond fell 7.5 basis points to 8.63% (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 23 Nov 2026), ahead of Moody's and S&P reviews late on Friday 27 Nov. Before the US open, S&P 500 futures were up about 2.6% and Nasdaq 100 futures about 3%, and Nvidia was up about 8% after President Trump again called for Jensen Huang's return, while Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the government will look into Nvidia's chip sales to China (Yahoo Finance and Investing.com, 23 Nov 2026). Gold was near $3,620 (+3%) and Brent near $89 (Yahoo Finance via LRC Forex & Commodities scan, 23 Nov 2026); markets price about a 91-92% chance of a Fed rate hike on 9 Dec, with US PCE inflation due on Wednesday 25 Nov (Yahoo Finance, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: Nvidia up about 8% before the US open; Treasury Secretary Bessent says the government will look into its chip sales to China
items.summary: Nvidia rose about 8% in pre-market trade on Monday 23 Nov 2026 after President Trump renewed his call to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO (Yahoo Finance, 23 Nov 2026, 03:00 PST). On CBS's Face the Nation, Bessent said the government will look into Nvidia's China chip sales and "will discover who oversaw compliance", adding that officials had been in touch with temporary management, lead directors and lawyers. Investing.com reports Huang and Nvidia's general counsel are due before congressional committees early next month and the FBI has opened investigations (Investing.com, 23 Nov 2026). The stock fell 14.0% to $125.53 on Friday; this is news flow only and does not change our rating.

items.title: US stock futures rebound about 2% as Asia tries to steady markets after the AI rout
items.summary: S&P 500 futures were up about 2% and Nasdaq 100 futures nearly 3% in Asian trade on Monday 23 Nov 2026, after the Nasdaq's 10% weekly drop, its biggest since March 2020. South Korea's KOSPI fell about 5% to a 10-month low while Taiwan rose 2%; South Korea, Taiwan and China announced steps to steady their markets. Reuters says investors doubt that borrowed money spent on AI data centres will earn returns fast enough, and that a lasting rebound may need a change in central bank policy (Reuters via MarketScreener, 23 Nov 2026). Futures can reverse before the US open.

items.title: Pre-market: S&P 500 futures +2.6%, Nasdaq 100 futures +3%, Dow futures +1.9%; VIX down to about 30
items.summary: US stock futures held their rebound after the S&P 500 fell for seven straight days and closed in a correction on Friday (Yahoo Finance live blog, updated 03:00 PST 23 Nov 2026). Yardeni cut its year-end S&P 500 target to 7,500 from 7,900, and HPE reports after Monday's close (Investing.com, 23 Nov 2026). Prediction and bond markets price about a 91-92% chance of a Fed hike on 9 Dec (Yahoo Finance, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: Week ahead: Dell results on Tuesday, Fed rate path in focus, markets shut Thursday
items.summary: Reuters names Dell's results on Tue 24 Nov 2026 and whether the Fed raises rates next month as the next tests for the market; Dell fell 11.0% to $278.02 on Friday 20 Nov 2026. Morgan Stanley expects big cloud companies' spending on AI to rise more than 70% next year to above $1.6 trillion (Reuters via MarketScreener, 23 Nov 2026). US markets are closed on Thursday 26 Nov for Thanksgiving.

items.title: S&P 500 6,910.39 (-3.7%), Nasdaq 22,617.73 (-5.3%), Dow 48,147.33 (-1.9%)
items.summary: Friday 20 Nov 2026 was the S&P 500's seventh straight daily fall; on the week the S&P 500 lost 8.6%, the Nasdaq 10% and the Dow 8%, the worst week since early April 2025. The S&P 500 and Dow are now in correction (more than 10% below their highs), the Nasdaq is down about 3% for 2026, and the VIX volatility gauge rose 26% to near 36. The 10-year Treasury yield was about 4.91–4.94% (Investopedia via Yahoo Finance; Alain Guillot recap, 20 Nov 2026).

items.title: Rand firms 0.9% to R17.43/$; 2035 bond yield down 7.5 basis points to 8.63%
items.summary: The rand traded at 17.4325 per dollar at 06:34 GMT on Monday 23 Nov 2026, about 0.9% firmer, helped by higher commodity prices and a weaker dollar; platinum gained 1.2%. Umkhulu Treasury's Adam Phillips said the big number this week is US PCE inflation on Wednesday (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: WeBuyCars headline earnings per share fall 18.6%; founders step back, Wynand Beukes to be CEO from 1 Jan 2027
items.summary: In results for the year to 30 September 2026, published Monday 23 Nov 2026, WeBuyCars said headline earnings per share fell 18.6% to 182.8c even though revenue rose 7.2% to R28.3 billion and cars sold rose 4% to 186,220. The final dividend was cut 43% to 17c (full year 50c, from 60c). The company blamed pressure on gross margins in a falling used-car market, as cheaper Chinese and other Asian brands reached 20% of new passenger car sales in 2026. Co-founders Faan and Dirk van der Walt are stepping back; deputy CEO Wynand Beukes takes over as group CEO on 1 Jan 2027 (TechCentral, 23 Nov 2026). WeBuyCars is not on our coverage list.

items.title: Moody's and S&P reviews of South Africa due late on Friday 27 Nov, both on positive outlooks
items.summary: Both agencies are scheduled to publish their South Africa reviews late this coming Friday; each currently has a positive outlook on the country (BusinessTech Africa, 23 Nov 2026). An upgrade or a change in outlook would be a market-moving event for the rand and SA bonds.

items.title: Shoprite to buy back and cancel about 265 million deferred shares; Continental proposes closing its Gqeberha tyre plant
items.summary: Shoprite plans to buy and cancel about 265 million deferred shares held by Thibault Square Financial Services, with Titan receiving about 1.8 million new ordinary shares worth roughly R600 million; other shareholders' voting interest would rise from about 59.9% to 88.7%. Continental AG has proposed closing its Gqeberha tyre plant, which supports about 950 jobs, and the dtic plans urgent talks (BusinessTech Africa, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: JSE starts the week after a 1.5% fall on Friday; All Share 104,638.77, Top 40 96,832.98
items.summary: The JSE closed on 20 Nov 2026 before most of Wall Street's Friday selling, so rand-hedge and tech-linked shares such as Naspers (-4.6% on Friday at R628) and Prosus (-3.5%) may again feel US moves (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance). A weekend market note found about two-thirds of JSE shares it tracks in weak or oversold trends, with telecoms (Vodacom, Telkom, MTN) and food retailers (Shoprite, Pick n Pay) the relative strong spots (Unum Capital, 22 Nov 2026).

items.title: Midday: Brent -3.8% to $89.04, WTI -1.4% to $82.82; gold +2.9% to $3,619, silver +3.4% to $42.41; rand flat at R17.46/$
items.summary: Prices at 12:48 SAST on Mon 23 Nov 2026. Oil has given back more ground since the morning, when Brent was near $92.65, while gold and silver extend their gains. Platinum was $1,302.20 (+1.0%) and copper $5.525/lb (+0.9%). EUR/USD 1.0975, GBP/USD 1.3112. Cheaper oil helps the fuel-price outlook for South Africa; firmer precious metals support JSE gold and PGM miners.
items.source: LRC Forex & Commodities scan / Yahoo Finance

items.title: Rand about R17.46/$ before the JSE open; gold near $3,606, platinum $1,294.50, Brent $92.65
items.summary: At about 07:15 SAST on 23 Nov 2026 the rand traded at about 17.46 to the dollar (range R17.44–R17.59). Gold futures were up about 2% at around $3,606.04 an ounce, silver up over 2.6% near $42.16, platinum up about 0.4% at $1,294.50 and palladium near $987. Brent was quoted at $92.65 and WTI at $83.48; EUR/USD was 1.0982 and GBP/USD 1.3110 (BusinessTech Africa, 23 Nov 2026). The dollar mostly held Friday's gains and briefly rose above 159 yen (Reuters via MarketScreener, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: Nvidia: Reuters links Friday's chip sell-off to doubts over customer financing after Jensen Huang's exit; see Breaking for Monday's rebound
items.summary: Nvidia closed at $125.53 on Friday 20 Nov 2026, down 14.0% on the day and 22.9% over five days. Reuters reports the chip sell-off is tied to doubts about Nvidia's strategy of financing some customers after the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, and Nasdaq 100 futures were up nearly 3% in Asia on Monday (Reuters via MarketScreener, 23 Nov 2026). Nvidia's rating is unchanged; it will be checked against its trigger levels by the analyst, not by this desk.

items.title: Nvidia -14.0% to $125.53, Intuit -12.8% to $270.44, Meta -5.9% to $560.84, Deckers -1.3% to $77.94
items.summary: Friday 20 Nov 2026 closes (LRC Stock Scanner, Yahoo Finance prices). Intuit extended Thursday's fall after cutting its full-year revenue outlook (Intuit 8-K, 19 Nov 2026); Meta and Nvidia fell with the wider AI sell-off. No ratings have changed.

items.title: MTN at R221.80 and Telkom at R66.37 going into the week
items.summary: Both closed lower on 20 Nov 2026 (MTN -1.3%, Telkom -1.0%) but telecoms remain the JSE's relatively strongest group in recent trading (LRC Stock Scanner; Unum Capital, 22 Nov 2026). No ratings have changed.
